scope: Scoped data integrity/statistical reconstruction; not product, Rust parity or formal full-suite acceptance.

scoped_test_log.note: Zero-test targets contribute zero, not a separate pass.

limitations: Session per-request Verify=1 and native success are asserted by the hash-bound probe before emitting each row; full CompileReport and native stdout are not separately persisted for those requests. Raw phase records independently show one Verify execution.
CLI build records retain all native stdout and per-request ELF hashes; each run overwrites the executable, so only the final restore ELF per run remains for present-day hash verification.
All four windows have separate candidate CLI files preserved for current hash checks. Source/binary build provenance is separate from this statistical reconstruction.
Stage-4 process_cpu_ns includes compiler threads and excludes child linkers/native controls; it is diagnostic and not whole-build-tree CPU. Stage-3 has no such field.
CLI ru_maxrss is child high-water RSS; Session VmRSS is a post-request sample. They are different metrics and cannot be combined into a peak-memory claim.
Phase fields are time between observer events, including intervening driver work; they are not exclusive phase CPU cost.
Session private pools five consecutive edits per arm/run. Each block/arm mean has ten private samples versus two for other request labels.
Rust reference is direct rustc O0/metadata with its stated incremental/CGU flags, not Cargo or full language/product parity.
No benchmark was rerun; all unfavorable cells are retained in the review.
